name: ESG Disclosure Form 2024
description: Minimal ESG disclosure form. Each field is pulled from the company's sustainability report and/or the internal company API.

fields.name: scope_1_tco2e
fields.description: Direct greenhouse-gas emissions from owned or controlled sources, in tonnes CO2 equivalent.

fields.name: scope_2_tco2e
fields.description: Indirect emissions from purchased electricity, heat, steam or cooling, in tonnes CO2 equivalent.

fields.name: scope_3_tco2e
fields.description: Other indirect value-chain emissions, in tonnes CO2 equivalent.

fields.name: water_withdrawal_m3
fields.description: Total freshwater withdrawal for the fiscal year, in cubic metres.

fields.name: headcount
fields.description: Total number of employees at fiscal year end (full-time equivalents).

fields.name: women_leadership_pct
fields.description: Share of women in senior leadership positions, as a percentage.

fields.name: renewable_electricity_pct
fields.description: Share of total electricity consumption sourced from renewable sources, as a percentage.

fields.name: lost_time_incidents
fields.description: Number of lost-time safety incidents recorded during the fiscal year.

fields.name: board_size
fields.description: Number of directors on the board at fiscal year end.
